name: persona-glyph
title: Persona glyph
description: Animated glyph tiles for site personas and static menu icons.
usage: Icons in the header's menu panels (`MenuGlyph` as a menu item's `icon`), persona cards and use-case links. Give each one in a list its `index` so they change out of step. 45 named pairs, from `scrape`, `batches` and `monitor` to `theme`, `team` and `generate`.
avoid: Line icons in a blue tile where the site uses a glyph

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
